**STEP 7 - Energy:** Fried egg ≈ 165 kcal/100 g. 120 g × 1.65 ≈ 200 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Two eggs at about 120 g and about 200 kcal is plausible for what is visible on this plate. The toast, avocado, and milk would add substantially more if included as part of the meal.
